Economy · India

Indian Rupee Declines Against US Dollar Amid Global Economic Factors

The Indian rupee opened lower against the US dollar, falling 11 paise to 95.49 and later 13 paise to 95.56 in early trade. This decline is attributed to increased market expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike, following hawkish comments from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. Rising crude oil prices also contributed to the pressure on the rupee, although other Asian currencies showed milder reactions.
